title: Lions’ Aidan Hutchinson questionable vs. Patriots after hurting knee on sack celebration
content:
MUNICH — Detroit Lions defensive end Aidan Hutchinson is questionable to return after suffering a knee injury early in the first quarter of Sunday’s game against the New England Patriots in Munich.

Hutchinson had recorded a third-down sack of Patriots quarterback Drake Maye when he got up, jumped in the air, pumped his right fist and landed awkwardly on his feet, immediately grabbing his right knee. Hutchinson remained on the ground before walking off the field under his own power and immediately into the blue tent. He then went to the locker room to be evaluated.

Maye also was ruled out with an ankle injury he suffered on the same drive. Tommy DeVito is in at quarterback for the Patriots.

Hutchinson entered Sunday’s game with five sacks in eight games for the Lions, who are 6-2.

This story will be updated.
